name: networkmanager
description: Amazon Web Services enables you to centrally manage your Amazon Web Services Cloud WAN core network and your Transit Gateway network across Amazon Web Services accounts, Regions, and on-premises locations.

subcommands.name: accept-attachment
subcommands.description: Accepts a core network attachment request.

subcommands.name: associate-connect-peer
subcommands.description: Associates a core network Connect peer with a device and optionally, with a link.

subcommands.name: associate-customer-gateway
subcommands.description: Associates a customer gateway with a device and optionally, with a link.

subcommands.name: associate-link
subcommands.description: Associates a link to a device.

subcommands.name: associate-transit-gateway-connect-peer
subcommands.description: Associates a transit gateway Connect peer with a device, and optionally, with a link.

subcommands.name: create-connect-attachment
subcommands.description: Creates a core network Connect attachment from a specified core network attachment.

subcommands.name: create-connect-peer
subcommands.description: Creates a core network Connect peer for a specified core network connect attachment between a core network and an appliance.

subcommands.name: create-connection
subcommands.description: Creates a connection between two devices.

subcommands.name: create-core-network
subcommands.description: Creates a core network as part of your global network, and optionally, with a core network policy.

subcommands.name: create-core-network-prefix-list-association
subcommands.description: Creates an association between a core network and a prefix list for routing control.

subcommands.name: create-device
subcommands.description: Creates a new device in a global network.

subcommands.name: create-direct-connect-gateway-attachment
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Web Services Direct Connect gateway attachment

subcommands.name: create-global-network
subcommands.description: Creates a new, empty global network.

subcommands.name: create-link
subcommands.description: Creates a new link for a specified site.

subcommands.name: create-site
subcommands.description: Creates a new site in a global network.

subcommands.name: create-site-to-site-vpn-attachment
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Web Services site-to-site VPN attachment on an edge location of a core network.

subcommands.name: create-transit-gateway-peering
subcommands.description: Creates a transit gateway peering connection.

subcommands.name: create-transit-gateway-route-table-attachment
subcommands.description: Creates a transit gateway route table attachment.

subcommands.name: create-vpc-attachment
subcommands.description: Creates a VPC attachment on an edge location of a core network.

subcommands.name: delete-attachment
subcommands.description: Deletes an attachment.

subcommands.name: delete-connect-peer
subcommands.description: Deletes a Connect peer.

subcommands.name: delete-connection
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified connection in your global network.

subcommands.name: delete-core-network
subcommands.description: Deletes a core network along with all core network policies.

subcommands.name: delete-core-network-policy-version
subcommands.description: Deletes a policy version from a core network.

subcommands.name: delete-core-network-prefix-list-association
subcommands.description: Deletes an association between a core network and a prefix list.

subcommands.name: delete-device
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing device.

subcommands.name: delete-global-network
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing global network.

subcommands.name: delete-link
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing link.

subcommands.name: delete-peering
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing peering connection.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes a resource policy for the specified resource.

subcommands.name: delete-site
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing site.

subcommands.name: deregister-transit-gateway
subcommands.description: Deregisters a transit gateway from your global network.

subcommands.name: describe-global-networks
subcommands.description: Describes one or more global networks.

subcommands.name: disassociate-connect-peer
subcommands.description: Disassociates a core network Connect peer from a device and a link.

subcommands.name: disassociate-customer-gateway
subcommands.description: Disassociates a customer gateway from a device and a link.

subcommands.name: disassociate-link
subcommands.description: Disassociates an existing device from a link.

subcommands.name: disassociate-transit-gateway-connect-peer
subcommands.description: Disassociates a transit gateway Connect peer from a device and link.

subcommands.name: execute-core-network-change-set
subcommands.description: Executes a change set on your core network.

subcommands.name: get-connect-attachment
subcommands.description: Returns information about a core network Connect attachment.

subcommands.name: get-connect-peer
subcommands.description: Returns information about a core network Connect peer.

subcommands.name: get-connect-peer-associations
subcommands.description: Returns information about a core network Connect peer associations.

subcommands.name: get-connections
subcommands.description: Gets information about one or more of your connections in a global network.

subcommands.name: get-core-network
subcommands.description: Returns information about the LIVE policy for a core network.

subcommands.name: get-core-network-change-events
subcommands.description: Returns information about a core network change event.

subcommands.name: get-core-network-change-set
subcommands.description: Returns a change set between the LIVE core network policy and a submitted policy.

subcommands.name: get-core-network-policy
subcommands.description: Returns details about a core network policy.

subcommands.name: get-customer-gateway-associations
subcommands.description: Gets the association information for customer gateways that are associated with devices and links in your global network.

subcommands.name: get-devices
subcommands.description: Gets information about one or more of your devices in a global network.

subcommands.name: get-direct-connect-gateway-attachment
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific Amazon Web Services Direct Connect gateway attachment.

subcommands.name: get-link-associations
subcommands.description: Gets the link associations for a device or a link.

subcommands.name: get-links
subcommands.description: Gets information about one or more links in a specified global network.

subcommands.name: get-network-resource-counts
subcommands.description: Gets the count of network resources, by resource type, for the specified global network.

subcommands.name: get-network-resource-relationships
subcommands.description: Gets the network resource relationships for the specified global network.

subcommands.name: get-network-resources
subcommands.description: Describes the network resources for the specified global network.

subcommands.name: get-network-routes
subcommands.description: Gets the network routes of the specified global network.

subcommands.name: get-network-telemetry
subcommands.description: Gets the network telemetry of the specified global network.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Returns information about a resource policy.

subcommands.name: get-route-analysis
subcommands.description: Gets information about the specified route analysis.

subcommands.name: get-site-to-site-vpn-attachment
subcommands.description: Returns information about a site-to-site VPN attachment.

subcommands.name: get-sites
subcommands.description: Gets information about one or more of your sites in a global network.

subcommands.name: get-transit-gateway-connect-peer-associations
subcommands.description: Gets information about one or more of your transit gateway Connect peer associations in a global network.

subcommands.name: get-transit-gateway-peering
subcommands.description: Returns information about a transit gateway peer.

subcommands.name: get-transit-gateway-registrations
subcommands.description: Gets information about the transit gateway registrations in a specified global network.

subcommands.name: get-transit-gateway-route-table-attachment
subcommands.description: Returns information about a transit gateway route table attachment.

subcommands.name: get-vpc-attachment
subcommands.description: Returns information about a VPC attachment.

subcommands.name: list-attachment-routing-policy-associations
subcommands.description: Lists the routing policy associations for attachments in a core network.

subcommands.name: list-attachments
subcommands.description: Returns a list of core network attachments.

subcommands.name: list-connect-peers
subcommands.description: Returns a list of core network Connect peers.

subcommands.name: list-core-network-policy-versions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of core network policy versions.

subcommands.name: list-core-network-prefix-list-associations
subcommands.description: Lists the prefix list associations for a core network.

subcommands.name: list-core-network-routing-information
subcommands.description: Lists routing information for a core network, including routes and their attributes.

subcommands.name: list-core-networks
subcommands.description: Returns a list of owned and shared core networks.

subcommands.name: list-organization-service-access-status
subcommands.description: Gets the status of the Service Linked Role (SLR) deployment for the accounts in a given Amazon Web Services Organization.

subcommands.name: list-peerings
subcommands.description: Lists the peerings for a core network.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for a specified resource.

subcommands.name: put-attachment-routing-policy-label
subcommands.description: Applies a routing policy label to an attachment for traffic routing decisions.

subcommands.name: put-core-network-policy
subcommands.description: Creates a new, immutable version of a core network policy.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a resource policy.

subcommands.name: register-transit-gateway
subcommands.description: Registers a transit gateway in your global network.

subcommands.name: reject-attachment
subcommands.description: Rejects a core network attachment request.

subcommands.name: remove-attachment-routing-policy-label
subcommands.description: Removes a routing policy label from an attachment.

subcommands.name: restore-core-network-policy-version
subcommands.description: Restores a previous policy version as a new, immutable version of a core network policy.

subcommands.name: start-organization-service-access-update
subcommands.description: Enables the Network Manager service for an Amazon Web Services Organization.

subcommands.name: start-route-analysis
subcommands.description: Starts analyzing the routing path between the specified source and destination.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Tags a specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from a specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-connection
subcommands.description: Updates the information for an existing connection.

subcommands.name: update-core-network
subcommands.description: Updates the description of a core network.

subcommands.name: update-device
subcommands.description: Updates the details for an existing device.

subcommands.name: update-direct-connect-gateway-attachment
subcommands.description: Updates the edge locations associated with an Amazon Web Services Direct Connect gateway attachment.

subcommands.name: update-global-network
subcommands.description: Updates an existing global network.

subcommands.name: update-link
subcommands.description: Updates the details for an existing link.

subcommands.name: update-network-resource-metadata
subcommands.description: Updates the resource metadata for the specified global network.

subcommands.name: update-site
subcommands.description: Updates the information for an existing site.

subcommands.name: update-vpc-attachment
subcommands.description: Updates a VPC attachment.
